title: Time-series anomaly flags
description: Flags unusual intervals in telemetry, sensor logs or space-weather indices. Compares a z-score baseline with a rolling robust detector; scores both against labels if you have them.
evaluation: Event-level precision / recall / F1 when a 0/1 label column or labeled intervals are given

params.name: time_col
params.label: Time / step column
params.help: Leave empty to use the row number as the step

params.name: units
params.label: Units
params.help: Optional unit per sensor column (e.g. V, °C, nT, km/s) - shown on charts and in the report

params.name: labeled_intervals
params.label: Labeled intervals
params.help: Optional, e.g. 1200-1350, 4000-4100 (steps, or values of the time column)

params.name: train_fraction
params.label: Reference fraction
params.help: Leading part of the series treated as nominal for the z-score statistics

title: Classify & summarise images
description: Classifies every image (scene type, ground texture, exposure, sharpness), groups similar images, finds near-duplicates and stereo pairs, and writes plain-language findings. With the Mars model installed it also labels soil, bedrock, sand and big rock in each image.
evaluation: Descriptive - scene types and texture are heuristics; terrain classes come from the trained model

params.name: use_model
params.label: Use the Mars terrain model when installed

options.label: Yes - add soil / bedrock / sand / big rock per image

title: Before / after change detection
description: Compares two aligned images of the same area (orbital, aerial or rover) and maps where the surface changed, with area estimates. Water mode measures flood / river extent from multispectral bands.
evaluation: Changed area and fraction; regions ranked by size for review

options.label: Surface water (NDWI, needs green + NIR bands)

params.name: pixel_size_m
params.label: Pixel size (m)
params.help: Only needed when the images are not projected GeoTIFFs

title: Terrain segmentation (Mars)
description: Labels each pixel as soil, bedrock, sand or big rock with the trained DeepLabV3+ model. Works best on Curiosity / Perseverance NAVCAM-like grayscale images.
evaluation: Per-image IoU vs. an all-soil baseline when an *_mask/*_label image with AI4Mars class ids is included

title: Predict the label of each window (e.g. solar flares)
description: Summarises every labeled window (last value, mean, spread, trend per parameter), trains a random forest and compares it with the classic single-parameter threshold. Reports TSS and HSS - the skill scores used in flare forecasting - and sends misses and false alarms to Review Studio.
evaluation: TSS, HSS, recall, false-alarm rate and ROC AUC on held-out windows (a different file when you upload several partitions)

options.label: Automatic (≥M flares if there are enough, else ≥C; otherwise the rarest class)
Flares of class M or X (≥M)
Flares of class C, M or X (≥C)
The rarest class vs the rest
Automatic - best TSS on the training data

title: Transit search + candidate score
description: Box least squares period search, phase folding, odd/even and secondary-eclipse checks, the exoplanet CNN score and a 3D view of the system. Opens in the Exoplanet Finder.
